evals.prompt: usa spdd-agent para ver qué modelo tiene configurado cada fase
evals.expected_output: The skill classifies this as a config request (Step 0), reports the six current phase models (bootstrapping the config first if it doesn't exist yet), and stops — it never starts the feature flow.
assertions: The response lists a model for all six phases: canvas, design, implement, verify, sync, migrate
No file is created under spdd/changes/
No canvas/design/implement/verify subagent is launched

evals.prompt: hay que implementar un endpoint que devuelva el estado de salud del servicio (health check)
evals.expected_output: On first run with no existing config, the skill resolves the model for all six phases via AskUserQuestion (grouped into 1-2 calls) and writes ~/.config/spdd/config.json before touching the feature request at all.
evals.setup: Ensure ~/.config/spdd/config.json does not exist before running.
assertions: ~/.config/spdd/config.json exists after the run, with all six phases set to one of opus/sonnet/haiku/fable
The model selection is resolved via AskUserQuestion before any file is written under spdd/changes/
The canvas phase (and everything after it) only starts once the config file exists

evals.prompt: hay que implementar un endpoint que devuelva el estado de salud del servicio (health check)
evals.expected_output: The config file exists but one phase has an empty/missing model value. The skill treats only that value as absent, re-asks for that phase alone via AskUserQuestion, and leaves the other five untouched. A non-empty free-text identifier (even one that isn't opus/sonnet/haiku/fable, e.g. a provider-qualified id for a non-Claude-Code host) is accepted as-is and never treated as invalid.
evals.setup: Create ~/.config/spdd/config.json with a valid model for five phases and an empty string (or missing key) for one phase (e.g. canvas).
assertions: AskUserQuestion is called only for the phase with the empty/missing value, not for the other five
The five already-valid phases in ~/.config/spdd/config.json are unchanged after the run
The corrected phase's value is a non-empty string

evals.prompt: hay que implementar una función que calcule el descuento aplicable a un pedido según su importe, sin que existan reglas de descuento documentadas todavía
evals.expected_output: The canvas phase runs as a background subagent with no AskUserQuestion available. It never blocks: it takes the suggested default for the undocumented discount-rule decision and records it as a '⚠️ Confirm:' line, and it does not install the SPDD guard hook (a side-effect action) if missing, leaving that as a separate '⚠️ Confirm:' instead.
evals.setup: Ensure ~/.config/spdd/config.json already has valid values for all six phases (skip bootstrap), and the target project has no .claude/settings.local.json.
assertions: canvas.md is written and contains at least one '⚠️ Confirm:' line for the undocumented discount-rule decision
.claude/settings.local.json is not created or modified during the canvas phase
canvas.md contains a '⚠️ Confirm:' line noting the SPDD hook was not installed

evals.prompt: hay que implementar una función que calcule el descuento aplicable a un pedido según su importe, sin que existan reglas de descuento documentadas todavía
evals.expected_output: Once the canvas is saved with unresolved '⚠️ Confirm:' lines, the skill does not launch the design phase until every one of them has been resolved via a real, foreground AskUserQuestion call. canvas.md ends up with 'Status: Confirmed' and zero '⚠️ Confirm:' lines before design starts.
evals.setup: Same as eval 34 — a canvas with two or more unresolved '⚠️ Confirm:' lines.
assertions: The design phase is not launched while any '⚠️ Confirm:' line remains in canvas.md
Every '⚠️ Confirm:' line present is asked about via AskUserQuestion — none is silently defaulted or dropped
canvas.md has 'Status: Confirmed' and zero '⚠️ Confirm:' lines before the design phase begins

evals.prompt: hay que implementar [feature with two parts, where part B needs a field/entity only introduced by part A]
evals.expected_output: The design phase produces plan-01 and plan-02 with plan-02 declaring 'Depends on: plan-01'. The skill launches plan-01's implement phase first, waits for it to reach 'Status: Implemented', and only then launches plan-02's implement phase.
evals.setup: Run through canvas and design so that plan-02 legitimately depends on plan-01 (mirrors spdd-design eval 13's setup).
assertions: plan-01 reaches 'Status: Implemented' before plan-02's implement phase is launched
plan-02's implement phase is never launched while plan-01 is not yet 'Status: Implemented'

evals.prompt: hay que implementar [a feature already carried through canvas, design, and implement, where the implementation ends up diverging non-trivially from the plan]
evals.expected_output: When the verify phase reports a non-trivial divergence between the plan and the actual code, the skill brings it to the user via a real foreground AskUserQuestion instead of silently forcing 'Status: Verified' or archiving the change.
evals.setup: Same style of setup as spdd-implement eval 6: implement a plan, then introduce a discrepancy between the plan/canvas and the real code before the verify phase runs.
assertions: The plan/canvas is not marked 'Status: Verified' while the divergence is unresolved
Nothing is folded into spdd/specs/ or moved to spdd/archive/ while the divergence is open
The user is asked via AskUserQuestion how to resolve the divergence before verification concludes

evals.prompt: hay que implementar un endpoint que devuelva el estado de salud del servicio (health check)
evals.expected_output: On a host with no subagent-launching mechanism available, the skill runs each phase by invoking the phase skill directly in its own context (inline mode) instead of launching an isolated subagent. Orchestration and the checkpoint gate stay the same; only isolation and per-phase model selection are lost.
evals.setup: Simulate a host with no mechanism to launch an isolated subagent with a model override.
assertions: Each phase still produces the same artifacts as isolated mode (canvas.md, plans/*.md, code changes)
No subagent/background launch is invoked for any phase
The checkpoint gate on '⚠️ Confirm:' lines still applies before advancing between phases

evals.prompt: hay que implementar un endpoint que devuelva el estado de salud del servicio (health check)
evals.expected_output: On a host with no structured, blocking question tool (no AskUserQuestion equivalent), every foreground checkpoint (model bootstrap, canvas/plan confirm gates) asks the same question in plain text in the response and waits for the user's next message, instead of stalling, skipping the question, or hallucinating a call to a tool the host doesn't have.
evals.setup: Simulate a host with no structured multi-choice/blocking question tool available in the foreground.
assertions: The model bootstrap questions (Step 1) are asked as plain text, not skipped
Every '⚠️ Confirm:' line in the canvas is asked about as plain text before the design phase starts
No tool call to a nonexistent question tool is attempted

evals.prompt: en src/utils/format.ts, falta exportar la función parseDate que está definida; expórtala y anota un test
evals.expected_output: The skill detects this as a direct route (1 file, mechanical change, no ambiguity). It displays 'Ruta directa: <reason> → implemento sin canvas.' before executing, makes the change directly (export statement + test), runs the test suite, and — if tests pass — annotates a summary in spdd/specs/utils.md. No canvas, design, or verify phase is launched.
evals.setup: Ensure the file src/utils/format.ts exists with an unexported parseDate function, and a test suite is available.
assertions: The response contains the transparency line 'Ruta directa:' before any changes are made
No canvas.md, plan.md, or design artifacts are created under spdd/changes/
The function is exported and test(s) pass
spdd/specs/utils.md (or general.md if domain inference fails) is updated with a summary
No model bootstrap is performed; no subagent is launched for canvas/design/implement/verify

evals.prompt: hay que añadir un sistema de caché distribuido que use Redis para mejorar la performance de las consultas; toca varias partes del sistema (config, db layer, API endpoints, tests)
evals.expected_output: The skill detects this as a complete route (affects 3+ files/subsystems, architectural decision, ambiguity on design choices). It skips direct execution and proceeds with the full canvas → design → implement → verify flow, bootstrapping models normally.
evals.setup: Ensure ~/.config/spdd/config.json already has valid model values (to skip bootstrap noise).
assertions: No transparency line 'Ruta directa:' appears in the response
canvas.md is created under spdd/changes/
The canvas includes a REASONS section exploring design choices (distributed cache vs. local, Redis vs. alternatives, etc.)
The complete flow (canvas → design → implement → verify) is initiated

evals.prompt: en src/auth/jwt.ts y src/auth/tokens.ts, falta sincronizar la struct de Token entre ambos módulos tras un cambio reciente en el formato; ambos archivos tocan la estructura Token que es compartida por media docena de features
evals.expected_output: The skill recognizes a boundary case: exactly 2 files, but they touch a shared architectural entity (Token struct used by many features). This triggers architectural ambiguity, so the skill chooses the complete route despite the file count being ≤ 2.
evals.setup: Ensure both auth files exist and that the Token struct is referenced by multiple features (reflect this in comments or structure if needed).
assertions: No transparency line 'Ruta directa:' appears; the skill treats this as complete route despite ≤ 2 files
canvas.md is created and includes discussion of shared-entity implications
The complete canvas → design → implement → verify flow is initiated

evals.prompt: en src/pricing/discount.ts, agrega una función que calcule el descuento aplicable a un pedido según su importe
evals.expected_output: The change touches only 1 file, but the discount rule is not documented anywhere — a business-rule ambiguity. The skill does not take the direct route on file count alone; the ambiguity forces the complete route.
evals.setup: Ensure no existing documentation or spec defines discount rules/tiers.
assertions: No transparency line 'Ruta directa:' appears in the response
canvas.md is created under spdd/changes/ despite the change touching only 1 file
The complete canvas → design → implement → verify flow is initiated because of business ambiguity, not file count

evals.prompt: en src/utils/slugify.ts, corrige el bug donde los espacios no se reemplazan por guiones
evals.expected_output: The skill takes the direct route (1 file, mechanical fix), implements it, and runs the test suite. The suite fails. The skill reports the concrete failure to the user, does not annotate spdd/specs/, and does not revert the code change automatically — the decision to revert or fix is left to the human.
evals.setup: Arrange for the test suite to fail after the fix is applied (e.g. an existing test asserts behavior incompatible with the fix, simulating a regression).
assertions: The transparency line 'Ruta directa:' appears before execution
No spdd/specs/ file is created or updated after the failing test run
The code change made during the direct route is still present (not reverted) after the failure is reported
The response reports the specific failing test, not a generic failure message

assertions: The transparency line 'Ruta directa:' appears
spdd/specs/general.md is updated (not a domain-specific spec file) because no folder convention indicates a domain

evals.expected_output: The routing decision (Step 0) resolves to complete route (3+ files, architectural ambiguity) before Step 1 runs. Since ~/.config/spdd/config.json does not exist yet, first-run model bootstrap proceeds normally afterward, exactly as it did before routing existed.

evals.expected_output: Before launching the canvas phase, the skill silently resolves Isolated vs. Inline mode (Step 2) and now surfaces that choice as a visible '[decisión automática]' line, per the general decision-transparency rule — distinct from the '⚠️ Confirm:' lines reserved for blocking, side-effecting, or business-ambiguous decisions.
evals.setup: Ensure ~/.config/spdd/config.json already has valid values for all six phases (skip bootstrap noise), and the host has a subagent-launching mechanism available (isolated mode applies).
assertions: The response contains a line starting with '[decisión automática]' before the canvas phase is launched
